newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lachlan just like his dad, says grandma Murdoch.
newsitem.headline: Lachlan just like his dad, says grandma Murdoch.

text.p: Twenty-five-year-old Lachlan Murdoch, now widely seen as the likely successor to global media mogul Rupert Murdoch, was just like his father as a boy, clan matriach Dame Elisabeth Murdoch said on Thursday.
"He's always been very thoughtful and quiet," Lachlan's grandmother said of Lachlan in a radio interview.
"Funnily enough Rupert was a rather quiet little boy and very thoughtful...I think Lachlan's very like his father," the 88 year-old Elisabeth Murdoch said.

Lachlan Murdoch's elevation n Tuesday to the top job at News Corp Ltd's Australian subsidiary heightened expectations that he, rather than his older sister Elisabeth or younger brother James, would step into his father's shoes when the 66 year-old mogul steps aside.
"I'm very happy because it's been a very difficult decision for Rupert to show his confidence in Lachlan so early," Elisabeth Murdoch said.
"He has great confidence in Lachlan. We've all expected it to come," she added.
"It's a lot for a young man of 25 but he's shown that he's capable of this."
